description: Write a late-fee reminder email for an overdue invoice. $0.01 USDC on Base per call. Calculates the late fee and returns a ready-to-send subject and body in a polite, firm or final tone. Bad input returns 400 and is not charged. Don't use this for sending email; it only returns text. [x402: pays from the caller's wallet (X402_PRIVATE_KEY); without a key the tool returns the live 402 price only.]
name: freesmallbiztools_late_fee_notice
title: Free Small Biz Tools API: GET /v1/late-fee-notice
